description: Unit test code for net::TestCompletionCallback, demonstrating usage and testing of asynchronous callback mechanisms within the net namespace.

classes.name: ExampleEmployer
classes.description: A toy class simulating a host resolver that schedules work via ExampleWorker.

classes.name: ExampleEmployer::ExampleWorker
classes.description: Helper class that performs scheduled work and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: ExampleEmployer::DoSomething
methods.description: Schedules work and posts a callback to be executed asynchronously.

methods.name: ExampleEmployer::ExampleWorker::DoWork
methods.description: Performs the work and posts a callback upon completion.

methods.name: ExampleEmployer::ExampleWorker::DoCallback
methods.description: Runs on the origin thread, invokes the callback, and resets the employer's request pointer.
